title: DelegationGrant (Vauban Pay spec v0.3 §4.5, Phase 2a target shape)
description: Phase 2a target shape for the DelegationGrant Claim, mapping to fiscal_authority (issue #2405) seven-field qualification surface. The DelegationGrant is a VPSF (Vauban Proof Stack Framework) Claim sextuplet: (Subject, Predicate, Evidence, TemporalFrame, RevelationMask, Anchor). The Phase 2a shape extends the Phase-MVP minimal struct (delegator, delegatee, scope, expires_at) with the cryptographic primitives that back bounded-spend authorization with cryptographic enforcement at use time. Canonical preimage discipline: JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) per RFC 8785, hashed with SHA-256 (lowercase hex), per x402-foundation/x402 issue #2326 v3 canonicalisation discipline section.

canon_version.description: Canonicalisation discipline revision per x402#2326 v3. Two accepted forms : (a) `x402-jcs-v1.0.0` (Phase 2a explicit prefix, recommended for new emitters), (b) `1.0` or `1.0.0` (compact form, backward-compatible with `stark-vauban-pay-v1` Axis 1 fixtures on PR #2413).

subject.description: VPSF sextuplet element 1: who is the Claim about. For DelegationGrant, the Subject is the user (delegator) who issues the grant.

kind.description: Subject kind. UserPseudonym = Poseidon(user_secret, app_domain, fresh_salt) per spec §2.3.

value.description: felt252 hex encoding (Starknet field element, 252-bit unsigned integer).

predicate.description: VPSF sextuplet element 2: what is asserted about the Subject. For DelegationGrant, the DelegationAuth predicate carries cryptographic spend bounds.

delegate_pseudonym.description: felt252 pseudonym of the agent receiving delegation.

cap_per_tx.description: Maximum amount per single transaction, u256 as decimal string (integer base units, no float). Maps to fiscal_authority field 4 (spend cap).

cap_per_period.description: Maximum cumulative amount per rolling period_seconds window, u256 as decimal string.

period_seconds.description: Rolling window for cap_per_period enforcement, in seconds. Max 1 year.

allowed_merchants.description: Allowlist of merchant felt252 pseudonyms or addresses. Empty disallowed; use a wildcard sentinel if open-set semantics needed.

allowed_currencies.description: Currency identifiers using URN pattern (e.g. urn:eip3009:USDC:starknet-sepolia). Maps to fiscal_authority field 2 (asset + network).

delegation_nonce.description: felt252 anti-replay nonce. Committed (not Open) in RevelationMask per spec §4.5.

max_chain_length.description: Maximum depth of grant chain (anti-inflation per spec §3.3.6 Delegation Chain Inflation threat).

evidence.description: VPSF sextuplet element 3: proof that the Predicate holds. For DelegationGrant, evidence is a StarkProofEnvelope over DelegationStatement (see spec §5.3 delegation_circuit.cairo).

scheme.description: Evidence scheme discriminator. Phase 2a: StarkProofEnvelope. Phase MVP fallbacks: HmacPhaseMvp (facilitator-internal), SnipSignature (Starknet wallet typed-data signing).

statement_kind.description: Required when scheme = StarkProofEnvelope. Identifies the circuit family that produced the proof (spec §5.3).

proof_bytes.description: Base64url-encoded proof bytes. Length depends on circuit (delegation_circuit ~120-200 KB Phase 2a estimate).

vk_commitment.description: felt252 commitment to the verifying key (anti-VK-substitution per spec §3.3.5).

grantor_signature.description: Phase MVP fallback: hex-encoded signature over the JCS canonical preimage of (subject || predicate || temporal_frame || delegation_nonce). Required when scheme = HmacPhaseMvp or SnipSignature.

temporal_frame.description: VPSF sextuplet element 4: time validity. ValidityWindow with explicit t_start and t_end.

t_start.description: Validity start, Unix seconds. Maps to fiscal_authority field 4 (expiry start).

t_end.description: Validity end, Unix seconds. t_end = t_start + period_seconds. Maps to fiscal_authority field 4 (expiry end).

revelation_mask.description: VPSF sextuplet element 5: per-field disclosure policy (Open = plaintext on-chain, Committed = hash-only on-chain, Hidden = neither). Per spec §4.5 default mask: delegation_nonce Committed, rest Open.

anchor.description: VPSF sextuplet element 6: on-chain commitment. For DelegationGrant, the StarknetDelegation anchor publishes the delegation_commitment to the chain.

chain_id.description: Starknet chain identifier as felt252 hex. Sepolia: 0x534e5f5345504f4c4941 (ASCII SN_SEPOLIA).

delegation_commitment.description: felt252 commitment over (delegate_pseudonym || cap_per_tx || cap_per_period || delegation_nonce). Maps to fiscal_authority field 3 (approval source binding).

revocation_authority.description: URL or DID that publishes the revocation list for this delegation. Maps to fiscal_authority field 7 (revocation or dispute path).
